thread:
ana: Quick heads-up — planning a small migration tonight at 23:30 PT. It's a column add + online index build on user_profiles (add last_seen_at, populate nulls, then create index concurrently). Target window ~30m. Who can own smoke and who will be primary rollback?

sam: I can own smoke tests. Will be available from 23:20. What's the exact rollback plan? :white_check_mark:

kevin: I'll be the deploy owner. Plan is: 1) run migration job, 2) monitor smoke, 3) enable traffic. Rollback: drop index if it blocks, revert column default + stop writers and fallback to previous code path.

maria: Adding note — we'll run the backfill with low concurrency to avoid bloat. Using the job runner with --rate-limit 50. If p99 latency creeps, we should pause.

ana: @kevin did you confirm no dependent views?

kevin: checked: only analytics_view references last_seen_at, which tolerates NULLs. I've added a migration diff in the PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/1847 

rahul: Oncall FYI — I'll be reachable but in grocery mode after 23:45. If we need immediate rollback ping channel and I'll join.

sam: Smoke checklist (I'll run):
- basic login flow for a few user ids
- profile read latency check (<150ms p95)
- write test creating profile (exercise default)
- run product e2e quick smoke job

kevin: Ops commands for quick rollback if index blocks:
```bash
psql -c "DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_user_profiles_last_seen_at;" $DB_URL
# If we need to revert default:
psql -c "ALTER TABLE user_profiles ALTER COLUMN last_seen_at DROP DEFAULT;" $DB_URL
```

maria: Also export the current index stats snapshot before build: `pg_stat_user_indexes` dump to S3. If we see bloat > 15% we abort.

sam: I'll post a ✅ when smoke passes and a ⚠️ if anything looks off.

deploy-bot: Migration job scheduled by kevin for 2025-03-12T23:30:00-07:00. Run ID: mj-20250312-23ak.

kevin: Quick rollback readiness check: backups done?

maria: Snapshot + logical backup taken at 23:10 PT. S3 path: s3://redwood-backups/user_profiles/2025-03-12-2310.tar.gz

ana: Minor ask — please ensure the feature flag to read new column is staged but off. We'll flip after 1m stable.

kevin: Yep flag staged. Flipping plan: 1) flag on for 5% -> 10m observation -> full rollout. If anything fails we flip off instantly.

sam: I'm ready at 23:20 and will start smoke at 23:35 after build completes.

rahul: If rollback happens, who's doing the actual DB commands?

kevin: I'll run the DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY and column revert. Maria will validate backups if needed. Rahul will own incident comms.

sam: final preflight quick tests I'll run at 23:25:
- `SELECT count(*) FROM user_profiles WHERE last_seen_at IS NULL;` (sanity)
- run a small backfill dry-run on staging job

maria: One more: watch free disk on replicas (index build can spike). If replica free space < 10% we abort.

kevin: good. tagging here so folks see: @sam @maria @rahul

sam: 👍 I'll post updates in this thread.

deploy-bot: Job mj-20250312-23ak started at 2025-03-12T23:31:12-07:00

sam: ✅ build finished, no errors, p95 read 120ms after index. Running smoke flows now.

sam: ⚠️ small write error on one test (unique constraint). Rolling back that job and re-running write tests.

kevin: Noted. Keep me posted. If it's flaky we pause and investigate.

sam: ✅ smoke passed after re-run. No regression observed.

kevin: Flipping flag to 5% now. Monitor for 10m.

maria: Observability: traces look normal, no anomalies in queue depth. Disk ok.

rahul: I'll update the deployment board and note rollback readiness still in place.

sam: all green from smoke side. 👍

kevin: Great job team — closing window at 00:05 PT if stable. If anything pops, use this thread and ping @oncall.

deploy-bot: Job mj-20250312-23ak completed successfully at 2025-03-12T23:52:43-07:00

maria: marking snapshots retained for 7 days per runbook.

ana: Thanks everyone — smooth handoff.
